name: Windows Peer Networking Services Disabled
description: Ensures the Peer Name Resolution and Peer Networking services are disabled. Passes when the service is set to Disabled (Start = 4) or is not installed.

validation.command: reg query HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\PNRPsvc /v Start; reg query HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\p2psvc /v Start; reg query HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\p2pimsvc /v Start; reg query HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\PNRPAutoReg /v Start
